bullets.text: Scotland vs. Denmark Showdown - Scotland faces Denmark in a crucial World Cup qualifier, streaming options available worldwide.
London Thieves Prefer iPhones - Thieves in London are increasingly returning non-iPhones to their owners after muggings.
Analogue 3D: N64 Revival - The Analogue 3D offers a pure Nintendo 64 experience on modern 4K TVs.
Magic Cue's Mixed Reception - Users question the ongoing utility of the Pixel 10's Magic Cue feature months after launch.
Steve Jobs on Pixar - A newly released interview reveals Steve Jobs discussing Pixar's early success.
iOS 26.2 AirDrop Upgrade - New AirDrop feature in iOS 26.2 beta allows syncing via PIN for easier sharing.
Meross Unveils Smart Sensor - Meross launches a battery-powered radar presence sensor with Matter-over-Thread support.
TikTok's New Well-Being Features - TikTok introduces badges for users limiting screen time and new mental health tools.
TikTok AI Content Control - Users can now adjust the amount of AI-generated content in their TikTok feeds.
Emm's Smart Menstrual Cup - UK startup Emm raises $9M to launch a smart menstrual cup with sensor technology.
